notes.title: Dwelling Halloween update (October 28, 2024)
notes.notes:
Greetings, Players!

In celebration of the Halloween season, we’re thrilled to bring you a spooky update to Dwelling alongside a limited-time discount during the Steam Halloween Sale! Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] Halloween Effects: Dive into an enhanced horror experience with Halloween-themed visuals and effects that heighten the eerie atmosphere.
[*] New Environmental Sounds: We’ve added spine-chilling ambient sounds to immerse you deeper into the haunting surroundings.
[*] Major Boss Level Update: Prepare for a revamped final Boss encounter, with new horror heights.
[*] Minor Bug Fixes: Several minor bugs have been fixed to ensure a smoother and more terrifying experience.
[/list]
Thank you for your support, and happy haunting in Dwelling!

notes.title: In-Game chievements
notes.notes:
New Features:

Achievements System: 
We've introduced an all-new achievements system! Now, you can unlock a variety of achievements as you progress through the game. Test your skills and see how many you can collect!
Bug Fixes:

Various minor bug fixes and performance improvements.
Thank you for your continued support! We hope you enjoy unlocking all the new achievements. Keep playing and stay tuned for more updates!
